{{field-1}}." :question/worked-solution "First, we express

$$
f(x)=-2(\operatorname{cos}⁡(x))^{6}.
$$

Now, we see that $f(x)$ can be expressed as the composite function

$$
f=-2{u}^{6},\,u=\operatorname{cos}⁡(x).
$$

Differentiating, we get

$$
\frac{\text{d}f}{\text{d}u}=-12{u}^{5},\,\frac{\text{d}u}{\text{d}x}=-\operatorname{sin}⁡(x).
$$

We now apply the chain rule, and get

$$
\begin{aligned}{f}^{′}(x) & =\frac{\text{d}f}{\text{d}u}\cdot \frac{\text{d}u}{\text{d}x} \\  & =-12{u}^{5}\cdot (-\operatorname{sin}⁡(x)) \\  & =12{cos}^{5}⁡(x)\operatorname{sin}⁡(x).\end{aligned}
$$" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/moderate :question/answer-fields ["8e0e8dd8-ac9c-5253-9528-54ce170da5b3"] :db/ensure :question/validate} {:db/id "c7a2b12a-811a-5b4b-be9f-b7b864c872c7" :answer/id #uuid "c7a2b12a-811a-5b4b-be9f-b7b864c872c7" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "-6{cos}^{5}⁡x\,\operatorname{sin}⁡x" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "15ed3388-c369-5661-8011-9ad85b8a7185" :answer/id #uuid "15ed3388-c369-5661-8011-9ad85b8a7185" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "-6{sin}^{5}⁡x" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "fc1ebebb-65a6-537a-9641-f6753ff84f0d" :answer/id #uuid "fc1ebebb-65a6-537a-9641-f6753ff84f0d" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "6\operatorname{cos}⁡x\,{sin}^{5}⁡x" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "1fefddaa-9b00-592c-976c-b15111b07144" :answer/id #uuid "1fefddaa-9b00-592c-976c-b15111b07144" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "6{cos}^{5}⁡x\,\operatorname{sin}⁡x" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "4ccb1a92-1ab5-55f6-a051-1d41270340a7" :answer/id #uuid "4ccb1a92-1ab5-55f6-a051-1d41270340a7" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "6{cos}^{5}⁡x" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "93ee8452-84d9-53fa-945b-db9c9f23d54d" :answer-field/id #uuid "93ee8452-84d9-53fa-945b-db9c9f23d54d" :answer-field/key "selection" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/radio :answer-field/choices ["c7a2b12a-811a-5b4b-be9f-b7b864c872c7" "15ed3388-c369-5661-8011-9ad85b8a7185" "fc1ebebb-65a6-537a-9641-f6753ff84f0d" "1fefddaa-9b00-592c-976c-b15111b07144" "4ccb1a92-1ab5-55f6-a051-1d41270340a7"] :answer-field/correct "c7a2b12a-811a-5b4b-be9f-b7b864c872c7" :db/ensure :answer-field/validate} {:db/id "1da4f94b-c6e6-57bb-95c9-efc33159af10" :question/id #uuid "1da4f94b-c6e6-57bb-95c9-efc33159af10" :question/problem "Find ${f}^{′}(x)$ when $f(x)={cos}^{6}⁡(x).$" :question/worked-solution "First, we express
